topics.title: The Absolute Participle Clause (Le Participe Absolu / Proposition Participiale)
topics.objective: Form and master absolute participle clauses (*proposition participiale*) to express anterior or simultaneous temporal, causal, or conditional circumstances in formal prose with an independent noun subject and without linking conjunctions.
topics.spacy_pattern:
# spaCy Matcher pattern for Absolute Participle Clauses (Proposition Participiale)
pattern = [
    # Pattern 1: Optional adverbial trigger (Une fois / À peine) + Noun/Determiner + Past/Present Participle
    [
        {"LOWER": "une", "OP": "?"},
        {"LOWER": "fois", "OP": "?"},
        {"POS": "DET", "OP": "?"},
        {"POS": {"IN": ["NOUN", "PROPN"]}},
        {"POS": "ADV", "OP": "*"},
        {"POS": "VERB", "MORPH": {"IS_SUPERSET": ["VerbForm=Part"]}},
        {"POS": "PUNCT", "LOWER": ","}
    ],
    # Pattern 2: Determiner + Noun + Aux (étant/ayant) + Past Participle
    [
        {"POS": "DET", "OP": "?"},
        {"POS": {"IN": ["NOUN", "PROPN"]}},
        {"POS": "AUX", "LEMMA": {"IN": ["être", "avoir"]}, "MORPH": {"IS_SUPERSET": ["VerbForm=Part"]}},
        {"POS": "VERB", "MORPH": {"IS_SUPERSET": ["VerbForm=Part"]}},
        {"POS": "PUNCT", "LOWER": ","}
    ]
]

topics.title: Pronominal Verbs with Idiomatic Meaning Shifts (Les Verbes Pronominaux Idiomatiques)
topics.objective: Master high-register pronominal verbs whose meanings shift dramatically through fixed pronominal clitics (*se*) and adverbial pronouns (*en*, *y*), including *s'en aller*, *en vouloir à*, *s'en prendre à*, *se passer de*, *y tenir*, and *s'y connaître en*.

topics.title: Register & Stylistic Variation (Soutenu Syntax vs Informal Spoken Shortcuts)
topics.objective: Master the syntactic, morphological, and phonological contrasts between elevated formal French (*style soutenu*) and informal spoken shortcuts (*registre familier/familier parlé*), identifying formal introductory locutions and spoken elisions.
